user.title: New list
user.description: A list lives in this integration and on its own card. Voice assistants reach it through Assist, and it can mirror the built-in to-do lists in both directions.

data.name: List name
data.notify_service: Notify service to fall back on
data.duplicates: Something that is already on the list

data_description.linked_lists: Built-in to-do lists this one mirrors, in both directions.
data_description.stores: Zones that are shops. An item can be assigned one; items without a shop can be bought anywhere.
data_description.item_types: Pick them all to let each item decide. Groceries and products are both bought — a grocery has a best-before date, a product a link to where it comes from — and a task has a deadline, a length and its tools.
data_description.link_products: Match item names against HomeBasket so the card can show pictures and details.
data_description.notify_arrival: Notify the phone that reported the arrival when you reach one of the shops above and something on this list is still open.
data_description.notify_watch: The people or device trackers to follow. Leave empty for everyone in the house.
data_description.notify_dwell: How long you must stay before the reminder is sent, so driving past a shop says nothing.
data_description.notify_cooldown: How long the same shop waits before reminding the same person again.
data_description.notify_unassigned: Items that can be bought anywhere go on every shop's reminder.
data_description.notify_service: Used when the arriving device has no app of its own, for example notify.mobile_app_phone. Empty leaves the reminder in the notifications panel.
data_description.duplicates: What happens when a product that is already open on the list is added again — by a scan, the card, an action or a voice assistant. A task has no quantity to raise, so there the one already on the list is kept either way.
